scope: Disposable, new PostgreSQL 16/pgvector container with no published host port; local archive only

globalRolesProvisionedBeforeRestore: network_copilot_app: NOLOGIN, no superuser, no createdb, no createrole, no bypassrls
network_copilot_local_login: LOGIN, NOINHERIT, no superuser, no createdb, no createrole, no bypassrls; may SET network_copilot_app
network_copilot_skill_collector: NOLOGIN, no superuser, no createdb, no createrole, no bypassrls
freshCluster.restoreCommandResult: pg_restore --exit-on-error --no-owner --jobs=4 with archived ACL returned exit code 0

limits: The disposable database ran in a local Docker engine, not on the selected cloud provider
A real deployment needs fresh role credentials, secure database networking and a new backup at cutover
This verifies database restore and selected privileges, not full Web, worker, HTTPS, concurrent writes or actual rollback
Restoring this archive elsewhere copies its existing data; whether real data may be migrated to a chosen hosting region remains an open user decision
